summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the ORILLA Carta Digital feature (/carta route). 29 behavioural tests executed across hero, filter bar, world filter (tab + URL + hero pick), accent-insensitive search, filters panel (category + diet + allergen exclusion), empty state, dish drawer (variants V01/V02 title & warning, formats, min qty), quick-add single vs multi-price, Mi mesa (count, total 38€ = 2×16 + 6, min-qty respect on line, persistence after reload, clear → empty, reserve navigation + summary), landing integration (nav-link-carta, hero-carta-btn, carta-pick-levante with URL + filter), CSS --bg morph, and mobile responsiveness. All critical flows PASS.

issues: Minor horizontal overflow of ~8px (scrollWidth=398 vs innerWidth=390). Likely caused by a '-rotate-2' banner div and SVG assets slightly exceeding viewport width. Marquees are correctly sized but outer containers may need an additional overflow-x: clip wrapper on the rotated banner section. /carta route has no overflow.

console_warnings.issue: React warning: 'Function components cannot be given refs. Did you mean to use React.forwardRef()?' Occurs because framer-motion AnimatePresence wraps DishCard with PopChild which forwards a ref, but DishCard is a plain function component. Fix: wrap DishCard with React.forwardRef or use motion.div as the exit-animated element. Non-blocking but spams console.

test_results.search_cafe_accent_insensitive_3_results: PASS (Flan de café, Café espresso, Tiramisù)
test_results.reserve_mesa_summary_text: PASS ('Tu selección de la carta: 3 raciones · 38,00 €')

action_items: LOW: Fix React forwardRef warning in DishCard (wrap export with React.forwardRef) to silence console noise caused by framer-motion AnimatePresence PopChild attaching a ref.

LOW: Address ~8px horizontal overflow on landing mobile (390px). Likely the rotated '-rotate-2 bg-[#F0285F]' banner element; wrap its parent in overflow-x:clip or reduce rotation at mobile breakpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: Carta.jsx useFilters correctly makes world filter deterministic from URL (?orilla=) and resets params when 'all'. Good.
mesa.jsx setQty uses Math.max(i.min||1, qty) — min-qty floor correctly enforced on both drawer and line adjustments.
DishDrawer image visibility correctly suppressed for V02 variant (showImg checks variantId==='V01').
Sheet.jsx registers ESC listener and calls getLenis()?.stop() while open — correctly re-enables Lenis on close.
DishCard should be wrapped with React.forwardRef to be AnimatePresence/PopChild-safe (ref warning in console).
seed_data_creation: localStorage key 'orilla-mesa' is cleared at test start, repopulated during flow and verified for persistence.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All /carta functional requirements verified: 35 dishes, 5 worlds, world filtering by tab/URL/hero-pick, accent-insensitive search, category/diet/allergen filters, empty state, dish drawer with variants (V01/V02) and warning, min qty for arroz (ORI-DISH-04 = 2 persons), quick-add single vs multi-price distinction, Mi mesa totals + persistence + reserve bridge to landing #visita with reserve-mesa-summary. Two non-blocking issues remain: a React forwardRef console warning on DishCard and ~8px horizontal overflow on landing mobile (not on /carta).
